input_messages.content: Hi, my name is John Doe. My phone number is 555-0198. I have been having a sudden high fever, chills, and muscle aches for the last 2 days. I also have a dry cough and feel extremely fatigued.
I have a runny nose, a mild sore throat, and I've been sneezing a lot. No fever, just a little bit of a headache and congestion. It started slowly yesterday.
